entities.name: Louis Béguet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Béguet was a French rugby union player who competed in the 1924 Summer Olympics. He was born in Neuf-Mesnil, Nord and died in Nantes. In 1924 he won the silver medal as member of the French team.
